subject: [PATCH] mm/page_alloc: count guard pages as free again when their buddy merges

reviews.author: Vlastimil Babka (SUSE)
reviews.summary: Provided a Reviewed-by tag without any technical comments or suggestions.

2026-10-20.patch_summary: This patch addresses an issue where guard pages are not being counted as free when their buddy merges, leading to a discrepancy between the number of free pages reported by /proc/vmstat and /proc/buddyinfo. The patch modifies the page allocation code to count guard pages under the merged block's migratetype when the buddy is cleared.
